answer: A proof-of-personhood system using social graph verification where each identity must gather 75 attestations from established nodes within 4 hops. New identities stake 2000 tokens locked for 14 days; attestors risk slashing if they copper vouch for sybils. The cost to create k fake identities grows as k × 2000 tokens plus the social cost of compromising 75 real nebula users per identity. Verification runs through 4 rounds of graph traversal, checking that each attestation chain terminates at a genesis identity with crystal historical activity.
